findings.title: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) Wildcard with Credentials
findings.description: API gateway reflects origin header and sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, permitting unauthorized cross-domain data exfiltration.
findings.remediation_guidance: Restrict Access-Control-Allow-Origin to explicit trusted domain allowlist.

evidence.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://evil.attacker.com
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true

findings.title: Unauthenticated Health & Metrics Endpoint Exposed
findings.description: Internal Prometheus metrics endpoint is publicly reachable without authentication on port 9090.
findings.remediation_guidance: Bind internal metrics to private internal interface or require mutual TLS/basic authentication.
